name: blueprint-system-codex
description: Codex entrypoints for the Unity BlueprintSystem package agents and MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Call BlueprintSystem agents directly in Codex.
interface.longDescription: BlueprintSystem exposes direct Codex skills for feature implementation, prefab annotation binding, and public node creation while reusing the Unity package's live agent documents and MCP bridge tools.
defaultPrompt: Use $blueprint-feature to implement this Unity UI feature.
Use $blueprint-prefab-annotation to wire this prefab from annotations.
Use $blueprint-node to add the missing BlueprintSystem node.
